newsitem.title: USA: Lockhart departs MasterCard for BankAmerica.
newsitem.headline: Lockhart departs MasterCard for BankAmerica.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp said Wednesday it appointed H. Eugene Lockhart as president of its Global Retail Bank.
Lockhart, 47, has been serving as president and chief executive officer of MasterCard International.
Separately, MasterCard International Wednesday announced appointment of Robert Selander to succeed Lockhart as president and chief executive officer of the global payments system.

As president of the BankAmerica's Global Retail Bank, Lockhart will be responsible for the consumer and small business banking areas now reporting to vice chairman Tom Peterson, who previously announced his intention to retire in 1997.
BankAmerica said the Global Retail Bank is traditionally one of company's strongest sources of earnings.
